title: Exemption to Barclays Finance Corporation of the Leeward and Windward Islands Limited (1976) Regulations
text:
Exemption to Barclays Finance Corporation of
R.S.A. c. A55 the Leeward and Windward Islands Limited (1976) Regulations R.R.A. A55-5
Revised Regulations of Anguilla: A55-5
ALIENS LAND HOLDING REGULATION ACT (R.S.A. c. A55)
EXEMPTION TO BARCLAYS FINANCE CORPORATION OF
THE LEEWARD AND WINDWARD ISLANDS LIMITED (1976) REGULATIONS
Note: These Regulations are enabled under section 16 of the Aliens Land Holding Regulation Act, R.S.A. c.
A55.
(Am. in L.R. 15/12/2006)
Exemption
1. It is hereby ordered that—
(a) Barclays Finance Corporation of the Leeward and Windward Islands Limited and its assigns or
successors (hereinafter called the “Bank”) are hereby exempted from the provisions of the
Aliens Land Holding Regulation Act in so far as that Act forbids an alien to whom a licence
has not been granted under this Act to acquire any land or interest therein—
(i) for the purpose of conducting its banking business,
(ii) taken as security for a loan while such loan remains unpaid, or
(iii) acquired in the exercise of any right or power of foreclosure or of execution upon
judgment and not held by such licensee for more than 3 years thereafter;
(b) any alien or alien company purchasing, and to the extent of, any land or interest therein sold by
the Bank in the exercise of any right or power of foreclosure or of execution upon judgment
unless at the time of such sale a person who is not an alien shall have offered such licensee a
sum sufficient to pay all principal, interest and costs unpaid and—
(i) secured by the mortgage judgment and incurred in the foreclosure and sale, or
(ii) included in the judgment and incurred in its enforcement,
may do so without a licence under the Aliens Land Holding Regulation Act; and
(c) any alien or alien company purchasing, and to the extent of, any real estate or any interest
therein acquired by the Bank under the provisions of paragraph (a) or by any other alien
company under the provisions of paragraph (b) may do so without a licence under the Aliens
Land Holding Regulation Act.
Duration
2. The exemption conferred by section 1 shall continue and endure until such land or interest is held by a
person who is not an alien.
